feedback:
Approved because one action run remains. A revise round would need a revision, a review and then a race, so approving is the only way this iteration gets a scored race. Nothing here predicts how the candidate will perform.

What the candidate changes: geometry.sensor_size goes from 0.012 to 0.016 m. Everything else matches the iteration 7 best (score 688.5): kp 2.8, kd 0.9, ki 0, base_speed 1.1, the iteration 4 spread (x = -0.024 to 0.024 m), sensor_weights [-2,-1,0,1,2] and line_loss 'last_direction'. The value 0.016 is an allowed option.

Earlier evidence behind the change: the slalom has finished 0 of 20 in every iteration. Its max_error has stayed at 0.061 to 0.064 across speed (iteration 4), sensor spread (iteration 5), kd (iteration 6) and kp (iteration 7). rms_error is low on every track (0.006 to 0.018), so the slalom losses are edge excursions, not poor average tracking. Sensor_size is the one lever not yet tried, and it changes edge detection without changing the signal scale. The rationale's geometry point checks out: with a 0.016 m footprint at x = 0.024 m, the sensor starts to read tape when the tape edge is about 0.02 m away.

Risk to weigh: the larger footprint averages over more of the tape edge, so the signal may be smoother and less sharp on the s-bend, which is the track most likely to lose completions. The oval and s-bend are the tracks to protect.

How the next iteration should read the race: if s-bend completion falls below 18 of 20 or the oval completion drops below 20 of 20, revert sensor_size to 0.012, since that is the best raced design (688.5). If the slalom max_error is still at or above 0.06 with sensor_size 0.016 and the oval and s-bend hold, the next test is sensor_size 0.008 with the same spread, to check whether sharper edge detection helps. If slalom max_error falls below 0.06 and line_loss_events drop toward 0.5, keep sensor_size 0.016 and consider a small further step.
requested_changes: If s-bend completion falls below 18 of 20 or the oval completion drops below 20 of 20 with sensor_size 0.016, revert geometry.sensor_size to 0.012, the iteration 7 best (688.5), keeping kp 2.8, kd 0.9 and base_speed 1.1.

If the slalom max_error is still at or above 0.06 with sensor_size 0.016 while the oval and s-bend hold, test geometry.sensor_size 0.008 with the iteration 4 spread, since the slalom has not responded to speed, spread, kd or kp changes and edge sharpness is the untested lever.

If slalom max_error falls below 0.06 and line_loss_events drop toward 0.5 with sensor_size 0.016, keep sensor_size 0.016 and hold base_speed at 1.1 and the iteration 4 spread, since iteration 5 showed the wider spread hurt the s-bend and oval.
